description: Starts a new conversation with the Barmaan team (support or sales), optionally about one of your orders (subject kind order + order number), projects (kind project + code) or service requests (kind serviceRequest + RQ-… ref). Without confirm:true it only returns a preview and sends nothing; call again with confirm:true only after the human clearly asked you to. A conversation about the same order/project/request already open is reused. Limits: 3 open conversations still waiting for the team, a few new ones per hour.

client_msg_id.description: Optional idempotency key (8-64 letters/digits/-/_). Retrying with the same key never sends twice.

confirm.description: false = preview only, nothing is sent. true = really send/apply after the human agreed.

name: thread_create
title: Start a conversation
